info.title: Forvis Mazars Regulatory Reporting Platform â API
info.description: Regulatory reporting for third-party management companies. One endpoint family per regime â PRIIPs KID, FATCA/CRS, U 1.1, O 4.1, ESEF, AIFMD Annex IV, SAQ and the BCL statistical reports â each validating a filing against the regulator's own rules and schemas before returning it.

Download a regulator document
get.description:
Serves the document inline by default.

It used to be sent as an attachment unconditionally, which is exactly why
the preview never appeared: a browser does not render an attachment
inside a frame, it saves it. The reference screen exists to *show* the
text, so the caller asks for an attachment only when it wants the file
on disk.

get.description:
The form as data, derived from the generator itself.

AIFMD is not one of the workbook-driven regimes, so it needs its own
route rather than the shared one: the four of those bind a generic
handler, and splitting them out left this one behind â which is exactly
the kind of gap the split was meant to make visible.

post.summary: Identify and check a return produced earlier
post.description:
The AEOI schemas are not bundled, so the return is read and identified
but not validated â and the answer says exactly that.

post.summary: The GDPR notification letters owed to reported holders
post.description:
Answers with the ZIP of letters itself rather than the envelope: the
archive carries account holders' personal data, so it is streamed once to
the preparer and not held anywhere on the way.

The counts are returned in headers so the client can say how many letters
were produced, and how many of them MS Word was available to convert.
